description: Lists Huawei Cloud EIP (Elastic IP, 弹性公网IP) resources — enumerates all EIPs in a region with public IP address, EIP ID, status, bandwidth, associated instance and creation time, using the KooCLI `hcloud EIP ListPublicips` command (primary) or the huaweicloudsdkeip Python SDK (fallback). Provides read-only EIP inventory for network resource auditing, cost review and resource discovery. Use this skill whenever the user mentions EIP list query. Triggers include: list EIPs, EIP list, query EIP, enumerate EIPs, show EIPs, elastic IP list, public IP inventory, 查询弹性公网IP, EIP列表, 弹性公网IP列表, 查看EIP, 列出EIP, 获取EIP列表, 查询EIP, 查询公网IP.
